messages:
Jules (marketing): Quick: need a one-pager battlecard for next quarter webinar. Focus: Competitive messaging vs cloud AI + API vendors. Two short pillars: 'Predictable Spend' and 'Operational SLOs'. 2 bullets each + one-line rebuttal.
Rae (growth): Lead with a dollar stat for Predictable Spend. Also propose CTA AB test: 'Estimate your token bill' vs 'See latency tail' on landing.
Samir (product): Bench snapshot: cached chat = $0.26/1k tokens; uncached ~ $0.70. Variant fallback raised success rate ~3x in congestion test. I'll drop the bench link.
bench-bot: Bench artifact: https://redwood.internal/bench/3120 (internal)
Tori (sales): Two quick rebuttals: "Why use Dedicated vs serverless?" -> "Dedicated gives committed throughput and predictable invoices; serverless can spike cost/latency under load." "Lock-in?" -> "Portable model manifests and transparent rollouts."
Wen (content): I'll draft 3 slide hooks + 4 short email subject lines. Examples: 'Pin your token spend' and 'Stop tail latency from breaking UX'. Need final bullets by 2pm.
Jules (marketing): Draft bullets (please edit):```
Predictable Spend:
- $0.26 / 1k tokens with prefix caching vs ~$0.70 uncached (bench)
- Committed Dedicated pricing + Optimize reduces month-to-month invoice surprises
- Rebuttal: "Hidden fees?" -> "Console shows token-level billing and route-level forecasts"

Operational SLOs:
- SLA-backed Dedicated cuts 99p latency jitter ~3x during congestion (bench)
- Smart routing + model-variant fallback keeps success rate high under regional pressure
- Rebuttal: "Vendor lock-in?" -> "Models & rollouts are portable across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments"
```
Rae (growth): Swap the cost bullets to lead with the dollar figure (people ask price first). I'll set up AB test tracking: bench-click, roi-calc, demo-request.
Tori (sales): I'll post two 1-line outreach opens (cost-first & ops-first) later today.
Jules (marketing): Action items: Samir confirm bench link & numbers by noon; Wen deliver slide hooks + subjects by 2pm; Rae spin AB test; Tori draft outreach. I'll assemble and publish the battlecard in #docs after edits. :rocket:
